title: Handbook of Planetary Methods for the Humanities and Social Sciences
text: A reference work of more than 40 chapters on the methods with which the humanities and social sciences study planetary change. With Clemens Finkelstein · Oxford University Press, under contract.

title: Planet as Method
text: Seed funding to explore a new research field on planetary methods in the humanities and social sciences: a joint cluster of the Universities of Giessen, Marburg and Darmstadt, led by Giessen. With Sven Opitz · Research Campus of Central Hessen.

title: Planetary Scholars and Artists in Residence Program
text: Annual focal topics, fellowships for scholars and artists, collaborations with academic and non-academic partners, including a theatre and an art gallery, and the Planetary Futures competition. With Claus Leggewie · Hessian Ministry of Higher Education, Research, Science and the Arts.
